The next segment, 46 to 57 seconds, shows the tractor winding up the wire along the field's edge. Finally, the last few seconds show a wide shot of a tractor spraying.

Now, I'll create concise captions for each of these one-second intervals. These captions are designed to be high-level summaries, minimizing verbosity. For instance, instead of "The young man is walking in the field," I'll write "Man walks in field."

Once I have all 60 captions, I'll format them into a JSON array, ensuring the output is valid JSON, with all strings double-quoted and no comments or control tokens. The array will be strictly formatted and concise, adhering to the 50% brevity requirement.

Finally, I'll review the output. I need to confirm that there are 60 captions, one for each one-second interval, with the start and end timestamps. I'll verify the conciseness and confirm that the JSON structure is completely valid.
